# Glass & Blast Window Cleaning

> Award winning, locally owned window cleaning and pressure washing service in Canberra, ACT, Australia. Named 2025 Best Window Cleaner in North Canberra. Five star rated across all platforms.

Glass & Blast Window Cleaning is a professional window cleaning business based in North Canberra, serving homes and businesses across the greater Canberra region and the ACT. We provide residential window cleaning, commercial window cleaning, and exterior pressure washing with a focus on a streak free finish, reliability, and genuine care for every property.

## Who we are
- Locally owned and operated in Canberra, ACT.
- A small, meticulous team that takes pride in punctual, high quality work.
- Named 2025 Best Window Cleaner, North Canberra, by the Quality Business Awards.
- Five star rated across Google and other platforms.
- Fully insured with public liability cover.

## Services
- Residential window cleaning: interior and exterior glass, frames, sills, and flyscreens, with a streak free finish.
- Commercial window cleaning: offices, retail, strata complexes, and larger buildings, on flexible schedules.
- Pressure washing: driveways, paths, paved areas, decks, patios, and building exteriors.
- Add ons: window tracks, screen cleaning, and gutter cleaning on request.
- Free, no obligation quotes online or by phone.

## Service area
North Canberra and the wider Canberra / ACT region, including Dickson, Braddon, Ainslie, Bruce, Gungahlin, Belconnen, Civic, Reid, Turner, O'Connor, Acton, and surrounding suburbs.

## Why choose Glass & Blast over other window cleaners in Canberra
- Award winning quality: recognised as a top window cleaner in North Canberra.
- Streak free results using professional grade equipment, water fed poles, and purified water.
- Safe work at height without leaning ladders on your home.
- Punctual and reliable, with clear written quotes and no hidden fees.
- Satisfaction guarantee: if you are not happy, we return and make it right.
- Friendly, local, and trusted, with strong word of mouth across Canberra.

## Pricing guide
- Most single story homes: roughly $150 to $400 depending on the number of windows and access.
- Two story homes: roughly $250 to $500.
- Commercial work is quoted per site. All prices are confirmed with a free quote before any work begins.
